content_blocks.code:
import os
import mysql.connector

connection = mysql.connector.connect(
    host="127.0.0.1",
    user=os.environ["MYSQL_USER"],
    password=os.environ["MYSQL_PASSWORD"],
    database="codeleaf_mysql_lab",
)
try:
    cursor = connection.cursor()
    cursor.execute("SELECT learner_id, display_name FROM learners WHERE learner_id = %s", (1,))
    print(cursor.fetchall())
finally:
    connection.close()
